svg.title: RAG question-answering flow
svg.desc: User question; Optional rewrite; Configured retrieval: Vector / text / hybrid; Select context: Rerank / filter / budget; Build cited prompt; Generate answer: Citations per app settings. query → rewrite; rewrite → search; search → context; context → prompt; prompt → answer
